detect_adsorbate_dissociation: build a python module using DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate has dissociated during relaxation
detect_surface_reconstruction: build a python module using DetectTrajAnomaly to detect if the surface has changed during relaxation
detect_adsorbate_desorption: build a python module using DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate has desorbed from the slab
detect_adsorbate_intercalation: build a python module using DetectTrajAnomaly to detect if an adsorbate is interacting with frozen atoms
compute_connectivity_matrix: build a python module using DetectTrajAnomaly to compute the connectivity matrix of an ASE Atoms object
